title: Lemon salmon with wilted spinach
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original food illustration for a recipe card. Subject: Lemon salmon with wilted spinach. Ingredient reference: Salmon fillet, Lemon, Spinach, Butter, Black pepper. Preparation reference: One batch makes 2 portions. Preparation: 10 minutes; cooking: 15 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 0 minutes. Cut the salmon fillet into two equal pieces. Wash and drain the spinach. Zest the lemon, then juice half and cut the other half into wedges. Melt 10 g of the butter in a nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Add the salmon and cook for 4 minutes on each side, until the centre reaches 63 C. Transfer to two plates. Add the remaining 5 g butter and spinach to the same pan; stir for 2 minutes until wilted. Stir in the lemon zest, juice and black pepper. Divide the spinach between the plates and add the lemon wedges..
